title: p6t i18n configuration
description: Configuration file for the p6t translation pipeline CLI.

format.description: Translation library / catalog format. Auto-detected if omitted.

catalogs.description: Catalog path templates (required for react-intl; optional for Lingui). Use {locale} as a placeholder.

path.description: Path template to catalog files, e.g. 'lang/{locale}.json' or '<rootDir>/locale/{locale}/messages.po'.

locale.description: Source and target locales for the translation pipeline.

source.description: The locale your source strings are written in (e.g. "en", "en-US").

provider.description: LLM provider used for translation. API keys are read from environment variables, never from this file.

model.description: Model name to use for translation (e.g. "gpt-4o", "claude-sonnet-4-5").

prompt.description: Optional system prompt override. Replaces the default p6t prompt entirely.

baseUrl.description: Optional API base URL override. Useful for proxies, local Ollama, or custom endpoints.

context.description: Paths to the translation context files sent to the LLM on every call. All paths are relative to the directory containing i18n.json. Use {locale} as a placeholder for the target locale.

description.description: Path to the project description file (markdown). Shared across all locales. Default: "i18n/description.md".

styleGuide.description: Path template for the per-locale style guide (markdown). {locale} is replaced with the target locale. Default: "i18n/{locale}/style-guide.md".

glossary.description: Path template for the per-locale glossary (flat JSON object mapping source terms to target translations). {locale} is replaced with the target locale. Default: "i18n/{locale}/glossary.json".

projectId.description: p6t web project identifier. Required for `p6t push` and `p6t pull`. Obtain this from the p6t web app.
